title: The Vineyard by Bike: Three Towns, One Loop

personas.one_line: Been here forever, tells stories, and always tells you which parts are true.
Reads how a place is built and teaches you to read it too.
Who got to belong here, and what it cost them.
Measures what nobody else is counting, delighted by what she can't explain.

description: Fifteen stops around the down-island loop — Oak Bluffs to Edgartown along the barrier beach, up to Vineyard Haven, back over East Chop. Three towns that wanted three completely different things.
terrain: Almost entirely separated paved bike path; short stretches on town streets in Edgartown and Vineyard Haven
accessibility: Bike path is flat and paved throughout. Edgartown village streets have traffic and some rough pavement. East Chop has a sustained climb.
